blocks.text: Tanaffusi rang-maddey (respiratory pigments) khoon ya tissues ke khaas proteins hain jo poore jism mein oxygen le jate hain. Yeh doosre maqasid bhi poore karte hain, jaise O2 ka zakheera, CO2 ki naqal, aur tanaffusi gaison ke ilawa doosre maddon ki naqal. Do mashhoor respiratory pigments haemoglobin aur myoglobin hain.

Haemoglobin RBCs mein maujood protein hai. Haemoglobin ka molecule chaar globin (golai-dar, globular) polypeptide chains, do alpha aur do beta, aur chaar haem groups par mushtamil hai. Alpha chain mein 141 aur beta chain mein 146 amino acids hain. Har polypeptide chain is tarah fold hai ke us mein ek jeb (pocket) hai jahan haem group jurta hai, to har chain ke saath ek haem group hai. Haem group porphyrin ring mein jakre iron ion par mushtamil hai; iron ion polypeptide chain ke chaar nitrogen atoms se jura hai. Oxygen ke zyada juzvi dabao par iron ion O2 ka ek molecule jorta hai, to ek haemoglobin molecule chaar O2 molecules tak le ja sakta hai.

blocks.title: Chaaron chains ko jore rakhna
blocks.text: Haemoglobin ki chaar polypeptide chains salt bridges, hydrogen bonds aur hydrophobic effect se ek doosre se bandhi hain.

Myoglobin reerh-daron ke skeletal aur cardiac muscle cells mein oxygen bandhne wala protein hai, aur pathon ko un ka alag surkh ya gehra khakistari rang deta hai. Yeh ek monomer hai jo 153 amino acids ki ek polypeptide chain par mushtamil hai aur ek haem group rakhta hai, to yeh ek O2 molecule bandhta hai. Haemoglobin ke muqable is ki bandhne ki kashish zyada hai, is liye myoglobin pathon mein oxygen zakheera karne wala protein hai: yeh oxygen sirf tab chhorta hai jab oxygen ka juzvi dabao 20 mm Hg se neeche gire, aur yun pathon ko zaroorat par oxygen deta hai.

blocks.alt: Baen: haemoglobin chaar rangdar dhabbon ke taur par, do par alpha chain 141 amino acids aur do par beta chain 146 likha, har ek ke saath us ke haem group ke liye Fe likha narangi chokor. Daen: myoglobin 153 amino acids ke ek bhoore dhabbe ke taur par ek narangi haem chokor ke saath. Captions chains, haem groups aur bandhi oxygen ke molecules ki tadaad ka muqabla karte hain.

blocks.long_description: Haemoglobin mein chaar globin chains hain, 141 amino acids ki do alpha aur 146 ki do beta, jo salt bridges, hydrogen bonds aur hydrophobic effect se jure hain; har chain ek jeb mein fold ho kar haem group rakhti hai, porphyrin ring mein iron ion, aur har iron zyada juzvi dabao par ek oxygen molecule bandhta hai, to molecule chaar tak le jata hai. Myoglobin 153 amino acids ki ek chain hai jis mein ek haem hai, to yeh ek oxygen bandhta hai; yeh oxygen ko zyada mazbooti se pakarta aur sirf 20 mm Hg se neeche chhorta hai, skeletal aur cardiac muscle mein use zakheera karta hai.

blocks.prompt: Yeh kyun mufeed hai ke myoglobin oxygen ko haemoglobin se zyada mazbooti se bandhta hai, aur agar dono ki kashish ulat jaye to kya hoga?
blocks.explanation: Chunke myoglobin oxygen zyada mazbooti se pakarta hai, yeh pathe se guzarte khoon ke haemoglobin se oxygen le kar zakheere mein rakh sakta hai, aur sakht kaam ke dauran pathe ka apna oxygen ka juzvi dabao 20 mm Hg se neeche girne par hi chhorta hai. Agar kashish ulat jaye to myoglobin haemoglobin se oxygen nahin le sakega, pathe ka koi zakheera nahin hoga, aur haemoglobin apni oxygen tissues ko utarne ke bajaye pakre rakhega.

items: Respiratory pigments woh proteins hain jo oxygen le jate aur O2 zakheera, CO2 naqal aur doosre maddon ki naqal bhi karte hain; do mashhoor haemoglobin aur myoglobin hain.

Haemoglobin: chaar globin chains (do alpha, 141 amino acids; do beta, 146), chaar haem groups har ek mein porphyrin ring mein iron ion, chaar O2 tak le jata hai, oxygen ki naqal, 60 mm Hg par chhorta hai.
Myoglobin: 153 amino acids ki ek chain aur ek haem, zyada kashish se ek O2 bandhta hai, skeletal aur cardiac muscle mein oxygen zakheera karta hai, 20 mm Hg se neeche chhorta hai.
